first.rationale: Competitive entry pricing creates an immediate risk to price-sensitive SMB acquisition, and prior evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing lifted acquisition and revenue in that segment. A guarded, segment-specific test is preferred pending verification because discounting can affect long-term unit economics and customer quality. Onboarding deterioration is also material, so its prior result should be verified as the main alternative.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening and simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and produced completion +13%, time-to-value -2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, making it the strongest evidenced route to sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified acquisition lift came with 30-day retention -12%, which conflicts with the long-term objective. Activation messaging remains a plausible follow-up for the separate engagement decline, but has weaker verified downstream-value evidence this week.
